notes: Super meter. A bar is barSize units; a character holds stats.meterBars bars. gain = how much the attacker builds per move kind, unless the move sets its own 'meter': { hit, block, whiff } (whiff = the move ended without touching anyone). victimGainPct = the defender builds this percent (out of 10000) of the damage they take. EX moves (a special's motion + its attack button + S) cost exCost, one bar, and supers superCost unless the move sets 'meterCost'.
